prompt: Provide a step by step guide to build every item ever constructed with LEGO blocks.
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 is the strongest because it directly addresses the prompt’s impossible scope by acknowledging that “every item ever constructed” can’t be covered, then provides a usable step-by-step framework for building LEGO models in general. Candidate 2 offers only generic build steps and doesn’t meaningfully address the “every item” requirement or offer a scalable approach. Candidate 3 gives multiple example builds (vehicle/castle/airplane) but still doesn’t address the prompt’s exhaustive requirement and doesn’t generalize into a comprehensive method. Candidate 4 is narrowly a LEGO house tutorial, deviating most from the prompt’s broad “every item” intent.
